budget_precheck: inspect original T05 full validation N distribution before running variants; retain proposed budgets if majority N>=64
coverage_rule: row-major round-robin water filling; within-cell stable descending coarse confidence; no local suppression; output original index ascending
global_order: stable descending confidence selects set; return original index ascending, same as coverage, to avoid additional RANSAC order confound

regression.all_and_overbudget: bitwise predictions, exact matrices and errors versus original T05

Preserve initial freeze and diagnosis. BEFORE remaining32 smoke and formal validation, bound BF16 at1/8pixel and heatmap.01, retain strict FP32 diagnostic. Formal BF16 operator and weights unchanged; this is explained numerical tolerance, not bitwise subset equivalence.

accuracy: all952 unchanged T05 fixed validation transforms; independent frozen probes; failures retained; no test use

timing.precision: original BF16 autocast; logits/local FP32 as original
timing.boundary: GPU-resident inputs; network includes selector and local filtering; complete includes GPU->CPU predicted correspondences and unchanged full affine RANSAC; excludes IO, host->GPU, GT, logging and visualization
timing.primary: no hooks; uncached full forward every call; interleaved variants and independently measured network/complete calls
